claim_boundary: Exact local Vitest workload only; production frequency, browser responsiveness, field devices, traffic, and retained-heap impact are unverified.

flow.name: scales across existing bucket-list sizes
flow.correctness_scope: The real full-corpus deterministic suggestion operation; no external database or network operation.

change.summary: Tokenize each existing title once and each pool candidate once per suggestion call instead of rebuilding both token sets for every candidate-existing pair.
change.behavior: Jaccard threshold, deterministic seed, category split, backfill, ordering, and return bound remain unchanged.

second_change.selected_by: The corrected combined heap evidence promoted shuffle as the first CPU-aligned allocation experiment without manual profile ranking.
second_change.summary: Replace decorate-sort-undecorate wrapper objects with a Float64Array of identical RNG keys and a stable sort of numeric indices.

verification.correctness: The nine-case output hash is unchanged; 48 focused tests and the full 484-test suite, typecheck, and lint pass.

second_change.claim_boundary: The allocation reduction is confirmed for the exact local 0/10/50-item workload. Largest-input latency and RSS did not materially regress; no production-frequency or retained-heap improvement is claimed.

third_change.selected_by: The shipped performance-lab CLI selected getBucketListSuggestions from two repeated allocation profiles, then a digest-bound continuation remeasured the same exact flow after the edit.
third_change.summary: Tokenize the immutable 5,000-item suggestion corpus once at module initialization instead of rebuilding every candidate token Set on every suggestion call.
third_change.tradeoff: The module retains one token Set per suggestion so repeated calls allocate less; production call frequency and long-lived retained-heap impact remain unverified.

paired_verification.correctness: 48 focused tests and the full 484-test suite pass; typecheck and focused lint pass.

correctness.name: is deterministic for the same inputs and seed

third_change.claim_boundary: These are exact local fixture-backed Vitest results. They do not estimate browser, production, database, network, field-device, traffic, or retained-heap performance.

correctness.focused_tests: 48 passed across bucket-list insights, experiences, and the scale contract.

codevetter_accuracy_improvement.observed: The first shared-corpus profile fully parsed about 22.9k heap samples per run but was marked truncated only because more low-ranked sources existed than the compact hotspot output retains.
codevetter_accuracy_improvement.change: Compact top-source projection no longer marks fully parsed evidence truncated; malformed structure and actual file, byte, sample, or node bounds still do.
codevetter_accuracy_improvement.result: The replay restored the repeated shuffle source at 2881944 and 2939664 sampled bytes, then the scaled workload promoted the broader allocation source and independent tokenize CPU hotspot.

scale_metric_capture.observed_gap: Vitest's JSON-only reporter preserved exact test identity and duration but suppressed the benchmark console line, leaving all four original capsules with an empty console_metrics array.
scale_metric_capture.change: Unprofiled Vitest executions now use JSON and verbose reporters in the same process, and the bounded parser accepts only an embedded object matching the Vitest result shape.
scale_metric_capture.claim_boundary: The scale values are short local microbenchmark medians and are retained to compare identical revisions and inputs, not to estimate production latency.

combined_heap_projection.observed_gap: Two individually complete heap runs were marked truncated after aggregation only because their source union exceeded the combined display window, suppressing an otherwise repeatable allocation finding.
combined_heap_projection.change: Combined evidence now propagates actual constituent truncation only; compact aggregate projection remains presentation-only.
combined_heap_projection.replay_result: The exact workload changed from insufficient_source_evidence to actionable, restored getBucketListSuggestions as the repeated leading source, and promoted shuffle as the first CPU-aligned allocation experiment.

autonomous_continuation.observed_gap: The laboratory stopped at source_edit_required, leaving the agent to reconstruct the post-edit comparison, and same-snapshot evidence from Node 24 was initially reused under Node 26.
autonomous_continuation.change: A new --continue-from run binds to the predecessor receipt digest and candidate, forces the same exact flow, records a conservative sequential screen, and still requires paired correctness verification. Node evidence from another runtime is retained but no longer counts as reusable coverage.
autonomous_continuation.real_product_result: The first continuation correctly returned no confidence for Node 24 versus Node 26. A runtime-compatible replay then predicted a material improvement, and independent interleaved verification confirmed it.

in_lab_acceptance.observed_gap: Even after a material continuation screen, an agent had to leave the laboratory and manually assemble exact correctness plus paired verification.
in_lab_acceptance.change: A continuation may now accept a distinct digest-matched incumbent and one exact correctness scope, run correctness in both checkouts, invoke the existing interleaved verifier, and persist its full report by digest.
in_lab_acceptance.real_product_result: One shipped CLI command accepted the Significant Hobbies token-cache candidate after both exact correctness executions passed and ten paired samples confirmed a 30.829% largest-input latency improvement with 66.594% fewer sampled bytes at the diagnosed source. The 1.274% RSS reduction is below the memory materiality threshold and is not claimed as a footprint improvement.

flow_owned_correctness.observed_gap: The agent still had to reconstruct and repeat correctness adapter, target, and exact name flags even though they were stable product intent for the measured flow.
flow_owned_correctness.change: A fixed bounded tracked data contract now joins exact performance identities to exact correctness scopes, exposes bound and stale counts, and requires the same manifest digest in incumbent and candidate checkouts.
flow_owned_correctness.real_product_result: The shipped CLI accepted the same Significant Hobbies candidate with only continuation, incumbent, and execution-bound flags. It selected the deterministic correctness test from the flow contract, executed it exactly once in each checkout, and retained the manifest digest in the receipt.
